name: write-complete-report
command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("results/overnight-20261111/20261110T235337Z")
report=json.loads((root/"b/analysis/report.json").read_text())
audit=json.loads((root/"audit/replay_and_integrity.json").read_text())
table=["| Task | Independent seeds | GOLD/TEST pairs | TEST continuation parity | Changed continuation contacts | Success disagreements | Raw / .01 / .10 rank reversals |","|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
for task,d in audit["B"]["by_task"].items():
    table.append(f'| {task} | {d["independent_base_seeds"]} | {d["complete_pairs"]} | {d["snapshot_continuation_passes"]}/{d["complete_pairs"]} | {d["contact_changed_pairs"]}/{d["complete_pairs"]} | {d["success_disagreements"]}/{d["complete_pairs"]} | {d["raw_sign_reversals"]} / {d["ranking_reversals_001"]} / {d["ranking_reversals_010"]} of {d["action_ranking_pairs"]} |')
table += ["","| Task / condition / stage | GOLD = TEST successes: nominal / alternative | GOLD = TEST utility contrast [paired 95% CI] |","|---|---:|---|"]
for name,g in report["groups"].items():
    p=g["policies"]; c=g["gold_contrast"]
    table.append(f'| {name} | {p["nominal"]["gold_successes"]}/7 ; {p["alternative"]["gold_successes"]}/7 | {c["mean"]:+.6f} [{c["ci"][0]:+.6f}, {c["ci"][1]:+.6f}] |')
path=Path("GATE_REPORTS.md"); content=path.read_text()
assert content.count("<!-- OVERNIGHT_B_TABLES -->")==1
content=content.replace("<!-- OVERNIGHT_B_TABLES -->","\n".join(table))
assert "OVERNIGHT_VERIFIED_STATISTICS_START" not in content
content += "\n\n<!-- OVERNIGHT_VERIFIED_STATISTICS_START -->\n"+chr(96)*3+"json\n"+json.dumps({"D7B":audit["D7B"],"B":audit["B"]},indent=2)+"\n"+chr(96)*3+"\n<!-- OVERNIGHT_VERIFIED_STATISTICS_END -->\n"
path.write_text(content)
print("Saved all 21 paired-action comparisons and exact independently checkable statistics")
